# Employment and Reporting
These policies cover reporting lines, grades and promotion for office staff.
## Reporting Lines - Office staff report to the [bold]Corporate Liaison[/bold]. - The Corporate Liaison is the senior Company employee on site. They speak for the Company and settle disputes between departments. - Any Company employee of grade [bold]WYC7 or above[/bold] outranks the Corporate Liaison while they are present, and takes over as the senior employee on site. - If the Liaison is absent or incapacitated, the highest-grade office employee present runs the office until the Liaison returns. - Work questions, complaints and requests go to the Liaison first. Staff may not go over the Liaison's head unless the complaint is about the Liaison.
## Grades Every employee holds a grade, which is printed on their ID card. Office staff hold the following grades: - [bold]WYC1 Trainee[/bold] (Trn.): probationary staff. - [bold]WYC2 Junior Executive[/bold] (Jr. Exec.): staff who have passed probation. - [bold]WYC3 Executive[/bold] (Exec.): experienced staff. May train new starters. - [bold]WYC4 Senior Executive[/bold] (Sr. Exec.): senior staff. Runs the office in the Liaison's absence.
Promotion is by time in post. An employee's grade can't be changed on site.
## Other Departments - [bold]Corporate Security[/bold] protects the site, its staff and its property. Staff must follow Security's instructions during an incident. - [bold]Research[/bold] staff work in the Company laboratories. Office staff may not enter research areas, and may not ask research staff about their work. - [bold]Company counsel[/bold] handle legal matters. Any contract, complaint or legal threat must be passed to the Liaison.
